expectations.text: Flags domain/note-policy.ts for importing the concrete simple-git implementation into the domain layer
expectations.evidence: Finding #1: 'The domain layer imports simple-git and calls it directly, but domain/ must contain only pure business rules and must not import Node adapters or concrete SDKs'

expectations.text: Flags the duplicated OpenAI SDK instantiation/call across summarize-note.ts and translate-note.ts instead of a shared port
expectations.evidence: Findings #2-#3 flag both files individually as importing/instantiating the openai SDK directly instead of through a port; finding #3 explicitly says 'Same violation as summarize-note.ts'

expectations.text: Flags src/adapters/note-slugify.ts as a cross-cutting-looking utility that is actually only used by one feature (notes)
expectations.evidence: Finding #4: 'This cross-cutting adapter is only ever imported by the notes module's HTTP route... violating the rule that src/adapters/ must hold only genuinely reusable, multi-module utilities'
